Ticket prices

Tickets prices may fluctuate at any point. The price paid for a ticket is as offered at the time of purchase and cannot be changed retrospectively. Concessions are only available by booking directly with Regent's Park Open Air Theatre.

Booking Fees and Charges

2026 SEASON

Tickets start at £15, plus £2.50 booking fee per transaction.

One-off events, including takeover days, music and comedy, are priced separately.

MONDAY PRICING

Monday Performances - Tickets for select Monday performances at £35, £25 & £15, plus £2.50 booking fee per transaction.

No concessions available with the exception of access prices.

UNDER 18s

Under 18s save 50%
Valid Tuesday - Thursday evening (and Thursday matinee) performances. Excludes Band AA, Band A & Band F tickets.

U18 tickets can be purchased online. Visit our FAQs for information about bringing children to the Open Air Theatre.

ACCESS

We will offer you the most suitable seat for you and your companion, but will only charge you the cost of the lowest price seat. There are no discounts for shows with a flat price.

No telephone booking fee will be charged on access bookings.

Read more about access

SENIOR CITIZENS

Best available seats at £45, plus £2.50 booking fee per transaction.
Senior Rate midweek matinee tickets can be purchased online.

GRASS BANKS

These tickets are subject to availability on a show by show basis.

Our Grass Banks, to the side of the auditorium, may be available on the day. Whilst we will assess the weather forecast at the time that Grass Bank tickets are released, conditions may change. Therefore, customers should note that they will be seated directly on the ground, which may not be dry. We recommend that you bring a blanket to sit on. Raised seating, such as deckchairs, are not permitted. Tickets will be released at 11am for matinees, and 5pm for evening performances. Tickets can only be purchased in person at the box office, and with a maximum of two tickets per customer.

GROUPS 10+

Save £5 on Price Bands A, B and C. Available on select performances, excluding Monday and Saturday evening.

Discounts can be applied on top of our preview discount.

Groups of 10-19 can be purchased online with no booking fee, or alternatively, over the telephone where a one-off £4.50 telephone transaction fee applies. Groups of 20+ can only be purchased on the telephone. With groups of 20+ the group leader goes free.

Excludes Saturday evenings. Group discount can be combined with preview discount. Discounts and free group leader tickets are only eligible on groups booked within Bands A, B and C.

All discounts and concessions are subject to availability.

Please note, discounts and concessions cannot be combined (unless stated) and are not available retrospectively.

A £2.50 booking fee per transaction applies.
